notes.content: Accountancy at CSU Northridge is an impacted major . To become an Accountancy major, students must first complete the following Pre-Accountancy requirements: Completion of a minimum of 60 units of CSU-transferable college work. Completion of ACCT 220 and ENGL 205 (formerly BUS 205) or their equivalents (see below) with a grade of "B" or higher in each. Completion of ACCT 230, BLAW 280, ECON 160, ECON 161, IS 212, MATH 103 (or MATH 150A or MATH 255A) and SOM 120 (or MATH 140BUS) with a grade of “C” or higher in each. Completion of ACCT 350 at CSUN after transfer with a grade of "C" or higher. To enroll in ACCT 350, students must obtain approval from the Admission Committee through an online application and have a total gpa and CSUN gpa or 3.2 or higher. A minimum gpa of 3.0 shall satisfy this requirement if seats are available. The CSUN gpa requirement does not apply to first-semester transfer students. After successfully completing all Pre-Accountancy requirements, student must file for a change of major to Accountancy. It is highly recommended that all lower division major preparation courses including Statistics and Calculus be completed prior to transferring to CSU Northridge.
notes.contentHtml:
Accountancy at CSU Northridge is an impacted major.


To become an Accountancy major, students must first complete the following Pre-Accountancy requirements:

  1. Completion of a minimum of 60 units of CSU-transferable college work.
  2. Completion of ACCT 220 and ENGL 205 (formerly BUS 205) or their equivalents (see below) with a grade of "B" or higher in each.
  3. Completion of ACCT 230, BLAW 280, ECON 160, ECON 161, IS 212, MATH 103 (or MATH 150A or MATH 255A) and SOM 120 (or MATH 140BUS) with a grade of “C” or higher in each.
  4. Completion of ACCT 350 at CSUN after transfer with a grade of "C" or higher.


To enroll in ACCT 350, students must obtain approval from the Admission Committee through an online application and have a total gpa and CSUN gpa or 3.2 or higher. A minimum gpa of 3.0 shall satisfy this requirement if seats are available. The CSUN gpa requirement does not apply to first-semester transfer students. After successfully completing all Pre-Accountancy requirements, student must file for a change of major to Accountancy.


It is highly recommended that all lower division major preparation courses including Statistics and Calculus be completed prior to transferring to CSU Northridge.
